onboardingPrompt.title: Do you already know how to study here?
onboardingPrompt.subtitle: If not, let NaHo walk you through the Marugoto path right now.

tour.pointHint: Click the highlighted area to continue

chooseBook.title: Pick a book
chooseBook.description: Start with the unlocked book (marked "In progress"). Click it to see the topics inside.

chooseTopic.title: Pick a topic
chooseTopic.description: Each topic has several questions and vocabulary sets. Click the unlocked topic to get started.

roadmap.title: Follow the roadmap
roadmap.description: Each node is a question, vocabulary set, or reward chest. Click a question node (mic icon) to practice speaking.

practice.title: Start speaking practice
practice.description: Review the prompt, vocabulary, and sample answer, then click "Practice now" to record your answer.

record.title: Record & get scored
record.description: Test your mic, then record your answer. The AI scores it instantly, adds points, and saves it to your history so you can review it anytime.

persona.title: Pick an AI companion
persona.description: Each companion has its own speaking style. Click one to pick your practice partner.

start.title: Start the conversation
start.description: Review your selection, then click "Start" to enter the chat room.

chat.title: Talk with the AI
chat.description: Type or tap the mic to speak Japanese. The AI replies, corrects mistakes, and translates right in the chat.

end.title: End the session
end.description: When you're done, click "End" then confirm in the dialog to see your results.

result.title: Review your results
result.description: Your overall score, per-skill breakdown, and improvement tips show up here, and are saved to your history so you can review them anytime.
